title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Administration Fee Figure Passed with an Approval
content:
## Clause

The administration fee that accompanies a Dangerous Goods Acceptance approval is fixed as follows. If an administration-fee entry is already dated on the handling date, it is 0.00. Otherwise it is the category's fee in full where the acceptance is under review and its booking is a live dangerous-goods booking (requested, confirmed or equipment released), and 0.00 in every other case. An approval recorded with a fee of 0.00 leaves no administration-fee entry on the account.

The figure is quoted to the cent as a complete tariff amount and receives no further rounding.

## Truth table

| Entry already dated on the handling date | Under review | Live dangerous-goods booking | Administration fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | any | any | 0.00 |
| no | yes | yes | the category's fee |
| no | yes | no | 0.00 |
| no | no | any | 0.00 |
